caption:
When you soften the point, they have to guess how serious it is. Say the issue plainly, then say what needs to change.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #difficultconversations

slides.label: Stop saying
slides.quote: “I’m not sure if this is a big deal, but…”

slides.headline: You shrink the <u>issue</u> before you say it.
slides.sub: Now they’re listening for your nerves, not the problem.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “This is a pattern I need to address.”

slides.headline: Don’t blur the point.
slides.sub: If it matters enough to say, say it plainly.

slides.headline: Say it out loud before you say it for real.
slides.sub: Steady lets you practice the hard conversation first.
